caption: The drawing depicts a three-legged metal cauldron with a long, slightly curved handle attached near the rim. The cauldron itself is round and deep, with textured shading to show a worn, rough surface. The three legs are evenly spaced and extend straight down from the base, supporting the rounded bowl above the surface. The handle, drawn with shading to suggest a cylindrical form, extends diagonally upward and has a hole at its tip, indicating it may be used for hanging or handling. The composition is centered on a plain, off-white background. There is a small signature “a. goldstein” in the bottom right corner. The drawing is monochromatic, rendered in shades of gray and black pencil or charcoal.
title: Skillet
